name: Lysandra and the Goblins
source:
An ambitious young human trader comes to a backward goblin village, intending to swindle the simple-minded creatures out of their land. However, a mysterious magic causes her to become uncontrollably aroused just as she is about to complete the trade. She ends up stuck in the village, overpowered by her newfound sex addiction, having constant romps with the little green-skinned creatures she has nothing but contempt for.

Will she discover the source of her curse and escape? Will she become a slave to her newfound lust? You decide!

[From [url=https://periapt.itch.io/lysandra-and-the-goblins]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位雄心勃勃的年轻人类商人来到一个落后的妖精村庄，打算将这些头脑简单的生物从他们的土地上骗走。然而，就在她即将完成交易时，一种神秘的魔法使她无法控制地兴奋起来。她最终被困在村子里，被新发现的性瘾所困扰，不断地与那些她只鄙视的绿皮肤小生物嬉戏。

她会发现诅咒的根源并逃脱吗？她会成为她新发现的欲望的奴隶吗？你决定！

[来自[url=https://periapt.itch.io/lysandra-and-the-goblins]Itch.io[/url]]
